csm_omar: Meridian Day0 reminder: we need final quota priming + autoscale guardrails before Fri dry-run. Can we confirm owners and a minimal ops checklist?
eng_lin: I'll own autoscale config. Ask Meridian for steady qps and spike profile.
ops_zoe: I'll provision burst pool and write the priming job. Pool will be 4xH100 in eu-west-1. Priming ~6m.
devex_anya: I'll prepare a 1-page runbook and a headless Locust job. Recommend test headers include `X-Test-Mode: true` to avoid billing.
csm_omar: Customer expects p95 <= 450ms, steady 600 qps, spikes up to 1500 for 3m. Renewal in 45d; flagging SLA sensitivity.
eng_lin: Proposed autoscale (posting inline): min=1, max=6, rps_target=750, cpu_target=55, cooldown=60s, burst_threshold=1200. If sustained >1400 for 2m, shift to burst.
ops_zoe: I'll stagger priming per shard to avoid thundering herd. Script will do `sleep $((i*30))` between shards.
infra-bot: Ticket created: Q-5542 (meridian quota). Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/Q-5542
devex_anya: Canary plan: 2%->10%->30%->70%->100% over 20m. Rollback on p95>600ms or errors>0.8%. Playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/dedicated-day0-handoff
csm_omar: OK final checklist: (1) eng_lin autoscale PR, (2) ops_zoe burst pool + priming logs, (3) devex_anya locust + ops checklist, (4) csm_omar renewal note. Pre-check Fri 19:30 UTC. Mark when done.
